craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of proclamation — the hammer now proclaims: breath demoted → rest unfolds → Māyā named → mother proclaimed → fence → double-held VERDICT. Unfolding order frozen (freedom→doing→lordship); feminine anaphora per BOUNDARY (viśrāntiḥ — ghost exorcised); nominal both lines. Rejected: (a) reordering offices → killed: unfolding order is doctrine. (b) neutering rest → killed by BOUNDARY feminine. Read aloud: REST, al-READ-y-TOLD … FREE-dom, FORE-most-DO-ing, AND-lord-SHIP in-its-TRAIN.

lines: Rest, already told — that very rest, all dependence barred:
freedom, foremost doing, and lordship in its train.
l4.sanskrit_cite: uktā saiva ca viśrāntiḥ sarvāpekṣānirodhataḥ svātantryam atha kartṛtvaṃ mukhyam īśvaratāpi ca
notes: both lines nominal, mirroring verbless SA (uktā … īśvaratāpi ca)

reads_against.argmap: What unfolds from rest? → Rest unfolds: freedom, then doership, then lordship — the absolute's offices from dependence-blocked rest.
c1_essence: Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).

Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).
